     Now craft explanation of two commits. Use markdown; summarise changes, purpose, tests.Last two commits

     ┌───────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
     │Commit         │Summary                                                                                                       │
     ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
     │31a7ff4 – fix( │Re‑architect the closed‑state landing‑search pill. Previously the pill’s glyph and input resided in the same  │
     │landing)       │element, so the border, width, and even focus state could change mid‑gesture, causing flicker and             │
     │               │inconsistent focus.<br><br>Key changes<br><ul><li>Re‑work the search field layout: the pill is now a <label>  │
     │               │that contains <svg> (the glyph) and the <input>. The glyph is placed before the input and is not part of the  │
     │               │interactive element, so the glyph never receives a click; only the pill (the <label>) does. <li>All layout    │
     │               │and styling of the pill (border, radius, width) is applied to the <label>, not the input. The input gets no   │
     │               │border or background, only padding and text styles. <li>Close‑state sizing is handled by the pill width,      │
     │               │while open‑state sizing applies via the same element, avoiding a DOM element switch. <li>Updated the CSS to   │
     │               │center the closed pill over the page and to keep it a pill rather than a half‑bar. <li>Added comments to      │
     │               │explain why the component is split this way. <li>Test simplification: the test no longer needs to know the    │
     │               │exact placeholder string, and it validates that the bar grows from the center (instead of the left).          │
     │               │<li>Fixed a minor typo in the test (.landing-search-box selector) and clarified the placeholder text.         │
     ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
     │0dd0c38 – fix( │Add touch‑screen handling for dismissing the search overlay when tapping outside of the results. Previously a │
     │landing)       │tap on a touch‑screen would fall through the floating overlay and trigger a pane underneath. <br><br>Key      │
     │               │changes<br><ul><li>Added a new test (tests/e2e/browser/keyboard.spec.js for touch screens + tests/            │
     │               │test_landing_search.js) that verifies tapping outside the open search closes it and does not activate the     │
     │               │underlying pane.<li>In web/index.html, added a media query for pointer: coarse that turns the search          │
     │               │overlay's pointer-events on; added an onclick="landingSearchBackdrop(event)" handler to detect a tap on just  │
     │               │the overlay frame.<li>In web/src/landing_search.js, rewrote the ranking logic to gather all hits first, then  │
     │               │slice to the maximum and finally group them by section. This guarantees sections requested by name (e.g.,     │
     │               │Terminals) are not drowned out by weak subsequence matches elsewhere.<li>Created landingSearchBackdrop(e) to  │
     │               │clear the search when a tap lands on the overlay itself.</ul>                                                 │
     └───────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

     Why both commits came together

     - 31a7ff4 fixed the closed‑state UI: a centered pill with an appropriate glyph and placeholder, ensuring a clean visual and
       focus behaviour.
     - 0dd0c38 extended touch‑screen UX: when the pill is open, a tap that is not on a search result should close the search. The
       overlay now stops click‑through on touch devices, allowing that tap to be captured by landingSearchBackdrop. This test covers
       the new behaviour and ensures the UI no longer accidentally opens a pane behind the overlay.

     These changes collectively improve the search component’s visual correctness, focus behaviour, and touch‑screen usability.
